title: SKP Processor
description: Processor replicas, selected by processor id and replica. Name and version come from the database row via the two-stage boot, so they are properties of the processor id rather than axes of their own.

panels.title: Gate open
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.gate.open`, minimum across replicas. 1 = the projection store is usable and consumers may run; 0 = the gate is shut and every delivery is being requeued.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Identity ready
panels.description:
0 means the pod is up and waiting for a processor row whose SourceHash matches its image. Running / NotReady with 0 restarts is the designed behaviour, not a crash loop -- this is the metric that makes that legible.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Not acked
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.messages.consumed` with disposition requeued or parked, over the last 5m. Split by `reason` on `Messages consumed by disposition`.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_instance_id)(increase(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"}[5m]))) > (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"} offset 5m)), 0))) or (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"} offset 5m)), 0))) or (group by (service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_gate_open_ratio{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.title: Produce faults
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.messages.produced` with outcome transient, unroutable or refused, over the last 5m.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_instance_id)(increase(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"}[5m]))) > (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"} offset 5m)), 0))) or (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"} offset 5m)), 0))) or (group by (service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_gate_open_ratio{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.title: Not acked (range)
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.messages.consumed` with disposition requeued or parked, over the visible range.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_instance_id)(increase(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"}[$__range]))) > (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"} offset $__range)), 0))) or (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",disposition=~"requeued|parked"} offset $__range)), 0))) or (group by (service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_gate_open_ratio{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.title: Produce faults (range)
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.messages.produced` with a non-accepted outcome, over the visible range.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_instance_id)(increase(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"}[$__range]))) > (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"} offset $__range)), 0))) or (clamp_min((sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"})) - (sum by (service_instance_id)(pipeline_messages_produced_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",outcome=~"transient|unroutable|refused"} offset $__range)), 0))) or (group by (service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_gate_open_ratio{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.title: Dead-letter depth (all queues)
panels.description: Measures `pipeline.deadletter.depth`, summed across this service's dead-letter queues, right now.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description:
Measures `changes(pipeline.process.start.timestamp)` across replicas over the visible range. The gauge holds the process start time and moves exactly once per process.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Messages consumed by disposition
panels.description:
Measures the rate of `pipeline.messages.consumed` by queue and disposition. Exactly one increment per delivery, on every exit path.

Legend: `{{queue}} {{disposition}} {{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (sum by (queue,disposition,service_instance_id) (rate(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval]))) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "acked", "", "") * 0) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "requeued", "", "") * 0) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_messages_consumed_total{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "parked", "", "") * 0)

panels.title: Produced by type and outcome
panels.description:
Egress. outcome != accepted is a fault.

Legend: `{{type}} / {{outcome}} {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Consumption balance
panels.description:
Measures the rate of acked `pipeline.messages.consumed` per replica. Replicas share one queue and the broker round-robins, so a replica near zero beside working peers is consuming nothing while still looking healthy.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Consumer duration by disposition
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.consumer.duration` — how long a delivery was held, on every exit path including the ones that never reached a handler.

Legend: `mean {{queue}} {{disposition}} {{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: (sum by (queue,disposition,service_instance_id) (rate(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_sum{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (queue,disposition,service_instance_id) (rate(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_count{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval]))) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_count{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "acked", "", "") * 0) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_count{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "requeued", "", "") * 0) or (label_replace(group by (queue,service_instance_id) (last_over_time(pipeline_consumer_duration_seconds_count{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__range])), "disposition", "parked", "", "") * 0)

panels.title: Produce duration
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.produce.duration` by queue — from the start of a send until the broker confirmed or refused it, publisher confirm included. p95, p99 and mean.

Legend: `p95|p99|mean {{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Queue wait by queue
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.queue.wait` — seconds between a message being published and a consumer picking it up, as a mean per queue and replica.

Legend: `raw|net {{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

targets.expr: avg by (queue,service_instance_id) (rate(pipeline_queue_wait_seconds_sum{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(pipeline_queue_wait_seconds_count{processorId=~"$processorId",processorId!="",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[$__rate_interval])) - on(queue) group_left avg by (queue) (label_replace(rate(pipeline_produce_duration_seconds_sum{destination=~"processor-$processorId"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(pipeline_produce_duration_seconds_count{destination=~"processor-$processorId"}[$__rate_interval]), "queue", "$1", "destination", "(.*)"))

defaults.noValue: no deliveries carrying a send timestamp in range

panels.title: Queue depth by queue
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.queue.depth` per queue — messages ready and not yet taken, from the broker's own passive declare.

Legend: `{{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

defaults.noValue: no queue depth reported -- nothing is probing these queues

panels.title: Consumers attached by queue
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.queue.consumers` per queue — how many consumers THE BROKER has attached. 0 means nothing is listening.

Legend: `{{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

defaults.noValue: no consumer count reported -- nothing is probing these queues

panels.title: Dead-letter depth by queue
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.deadletter.depth` per queue — refused messages nobody has dealt with yet.

Legend: `{{queue}} {{service_instance_id}}`

defaults.noValue: no dead-letter depth reported by this service -- see the panel description before reading this as zero

panels.title: Gate open and trips by replica
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.gate.open` per replica, with `increase(pipeline.gate.trips)` over the range beside it.

Legend: `gate|trips {{service_instance_id}}`

defaults.noValue: no gate reporting -- this replica is not exporting at all

panels.title: Gate probe outcomes
panels.description:
Measures the RATE of `pipeline.gate.probe.duration` observations, split by outcome — healthy, timeout or failed.

Legend: `{{outcome}} {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Gate probe duration
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.gate.probe.duration` — how long the projection store took to answer the gate probe. p95, p99 and mean.

Legend: `p95|p99|mean {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Loop iterations by loop
panels.description:
Measures the rate of `pipeline.loop.iterations` by loop. Expected: l2-gate 0.2/s, processor-liveness and queue-depth 0.1/s.

Legend: `{{loop}} {{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Identity ready by replica
panels.description:
Measures `pipeline.identity.ready` per replica. Red is a pod that is up and waiting for a processor row matching its SourceHash — the designed behaviour, not a crash loop.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Exception rate
panels.description:
Correlates with rising parked / refused dispositions and with faulted process outcomes. On the visible tier because a rising exception rate is a cause an operator should not have to expand a row to find.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Thread-pool queue length
panels.description:
Explains consumption stalling while the gate is open and the consumer still reports consuming=1: callbacks are starved, not blocked.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Thread-pool threads
panels.description:
Measures `process_runtime_dotnet_thread_pool_threads_count` per replica.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description:
Seconds of GC pause per second. Explains duration p99 spikes with no broker or dependency fault.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: GC collections / sec by generation
panels.description:
**The cause behind the pause time to its left.** Pause seconds answer *how much*, this answers *why*: gen0 is cheap and constant, and a gen2 rate that is anything but near-flat is the collection that actually costs you.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}} / {{generation}}`

panels.title: GC heap size by generation
panels.description:
Managed heap, by generation. **The leak signal**: a gen2 or LOH line that steps up and never comes back down across several collections is retention, and it ends in an OOMKill that every pipeline panel will report as a restart with no cause.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}} / {{generation}}`

panels.title: GC committed memory
panels.description:
What the GC has committed from the OS -- **the number the container limit is compared against**, not the managed heap beside it. The two diverge, and the gap is why a pod can be OOMKilled while its heap looks healthy: committed memory is returned to the OS lazily, so it tracks the high-water mark rather than the live set.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description:
Bytes allocated per second -- **upstream of every other panel in this row.** Collections, pause time and committed memory are all consequences of this number; it is the one that moves first when a transform starts allocating per message.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`

panels.title: Lock contention rate
panels.description:
Monitor contentions per second: threads that had to WAIT for a lock rather than take it. **The stall with no external cause** -- gate open, broker healthy, store fast, and throughput down anyway.

Legend: `{{service_instance_id}}`
